captured_from: the real NPSP->NPC v2 migration run (step 3), NPSP_SOURCE org, nonprofit subset only
note: FIRST concrete instance of ROADMAP #89 (Known Source-Shape Fingerprints), hand-captured from one real run's source data -- no registry tooling exists yet; this is the real example to generalize the tooling from later. Population/counts are from this run's scoped nonprofit subset (8 households) and illustrate SHAPE, not universal magnitudes. The recognition signature (packaged objects/fields) IS meant to be portable across NPSP orgs.

recognition_signature.description: How to recognize an org as NPSP from its shape alone -- presence of these packaged objects/fields is the fingerprint.

account_signals.household_model: npe01__SYSTEM_AccountType__c = 'Household Account' identifies a donor household (portable, unlike Type text or a record-type Id)
account_signals.rollup_fields: npo02__* currency/number rollups on Account (TotalOppAmount, LastCloseDate, ...) -- Disregard in migration (target recomputes), but a strong NPSP signal; these carry large scientific-notation values that need the scale-aware replicate coercer

recognition_signature.mixed_org_caveat: An NPSP dev/demo org commonly ALSO holds standard Salesforce demo Accounts (Edge Communications, etc.). Scope the migration to npe01__SYSTEM_AccountType__c = 'Household Account' + related; do not migrate demo/non-donor data.

Account (household).role: donor household; maps to target Account (RecordType Household) + PartyRelationshipGroup
Account (household).shape_observed: single-member households in this run (8 households, 8 contacts, 1:1); a real client may have multi-member households (unvalidated here)

Contact.role: the person; maps to a target Person Account (shadow Contact auto-created)

npe03__Recurring_Donation__c.role: recurring gift; maps to target GiftCommitment (+ GiftCommitmentSchedule)
npe03__Recurring_Donation__c.shape_observed: period mix Monthly/Quarterly/Yearly; recurring (Monthly/Weekly/Yearly) get a platform-auto-created schedule, non-standard periods (Quarterly, 1st-and-15th) map to a Custom schedule this migration inserts explicitly

Opportunity.role: a gift; ROUTES three ways by payment count/status -- >1 real payment -> GiftCommitment; else -> GiftTransaction directly
Opportunity.shape_observed: of 12 in-scope opps, 2 multi-payment (route to GiftCommitment), 10 single-payment (route to GiftTransaction)

npe01__OppPayment__c.role: an installment/payment; maps to target GiftTransaction
npe01__OppPayment__c.shape_observed: MIXED paid/unpaid -- 8 paid, 7 unpaid/pledged. Unpaid payments carry NO payment date, only npe01__Scheduled_Date__c. This is the reality the transform's Status/date mapping MUST handle (validators/GiftTransaction.md).

npsp__Allocation__c.role: splits a gift across GAUs; maps to target GiftTransactionDesignation (fans out when an Opportunity produced >1 transaction)
npsp__Allocation__c.shape_observed: not every gift has an Allocation -- a transaction with none relies on the target's auto-created default designation (open question for the architect)

key_mappings: Contact -> Person Account (Account) + auto-created shadow Contact + household-membership AccountContactRelation
Recurring Donation -> GiftCommitment + GiftCommitmentSchedule (recurring schedules auto-created)
Opportunity -> GiftCommitment | GiftTransaction (three-way routing by payment count)
